Dynamite-caught campfire barra.veg: Haloumi and zucchini parcels with lemon, ginger and coriander, wrapped in foil (or paperbark) and cooked over coals for 20 minutes.

Top End lemon myrtle gin and tonic.af: Gin-style spirit over ice with tonic, a lemon myrtle sugar rim and fresh lime, sharp and cold for a hot night in the bush.
